title: [Master][ALL-E] Document Type is Quote in Document Attachment table (1173) after posting a Sales Invoice with attachments.
summary: Document Type is now correctly set to Invoice or Credit Memo when attachments are transferred to posted sales documents, fixing an issue where the type was incorrectly defaulting to Quote.
key_points: Document attachments transferred to posted invoices now have Document Type set to Invoice instead of Quote
Document attachments transferred to posted credit memos now have Document Type set to Credit Memo
The fix applies to both header and line attachments
Both sales and service document attachment management were updated
Regression tests added to verify correct behavior
quote: Set the Document Type according to the posted document table instead of clearing it.
